title: Saturday Daily Practice
subtitle: Rewrite Introduction, past tenses and Speaking Part 1

intro: Work through 4 steps, about 85 minutes. You need Track 18 (sent by the teacher on Zalo at 7:00). Step 1 uses the teacher's feedback on the Writing you did on Monday. Deadline 00:00 tonight. Complete and on time earns 20 Meow; late or half done earns 10 Meow. Do not look at the answers before you finish.

steps.title: Step 1 · Rewrite Introduction
steps.instructions: Read the teacher's feedback on your Monday Writing. Rewrite the Introduction for ONE chart and fix every error the teacher marked. Check: the Introduction has all 5 points (what, who, where, when, unit).

open.model: The line graph illustrates the number of users of five communication services worldwide over a ten-year period, commencing from 1998.

ai.type: Viết lại Introduction cho Task 1 theo nhận xét của giáo viên
ai.task: Rewrite the Introduction of your Task 1 answer from Monday. Fix every comment from your teacher. The Introduction needs the five pieces (what, who, where, when, unit).
criteria: Introduction có đủ 5 ý và viết lại bằng từ khác đề bài
sửa các lỗi giáo viên đã nhận xét
ngữ pháp và chính tả đúng

steps.title: Step 2 · Past simple or past continuous?
steps.instructions: Fill in the correct form of the verb (one phrase). For question 5, fill in only the first blank.

items.label: 1. Last weekend, I (played / was playing) football with my cousins. ______
items.explain: Hành động đã kết thúc: past simple.

items.label: 2. While we (trained / were training), it started to rain. ______
items.explain: While + hành động đang diễn ra: past continuous.

items.label: 3. She (was winning / won) the match in two sets. ______
items.explain: Kết quả đã xong: past simple.

items.label: 4. I (watched / was watching) the final when the lights went out. ______
items.explain: Đang xem thì mất điện: past continuous.

items.label: 5. He (broke / was breaking) his leg while he (played / was playing) basketball. ______
6. At 7 p.m. yesterday, I (jogged / was jogging) in the park. ______
items.explain: Thời điểm cụ thể trong quá khứ: past continuous.

steps.title: Step 3 · Shadowing: Track 18
steps.instructions: Listen to Track 18 and shadow it 3 times: read along with the text, listen and read together, then without looking at the text. Stress the content words. Then answer the questions.

items.q: Which words are stressed in: I ran in the London marathon last year?
items.explain: Từ nội dung (động từ, danh từ, tính từ) được nhấn; từ chức năng (I, in, the) đọc nhẹ.

steps.title: Step 4 · Speaking Part 1 voice note
steps.instructions: Answer all 6 questions in one voice note of about 3 minutes. For each question: Answer, Reason, Example (past), Contrast. Use at least 4 words from Wednesday's lesson. At the end of the voice note, read the 2 shadowing sentences: Last weekend, I was going to go to the gym, but I decided not to bother. I ran in the London marathon last year. I thought I was never going to make it to the end!
lines: 1. What sports are popular in your country?
2. Do you prefer to play sport or watch it?
3. Did you play sport at school?
4. What do you do in your free time?
5. Would you like to try a new sport?
6. Is sport important for young people?
steps.note: Thầy sẽ nghe và nhận xét 4 bước, thì quá khứ và trọng âm.

send_today: Bài viết ở Step 1 và voice note ở Step 4 sẽ được gửi tự động cho thầy khi bấm Nộp bài.
